description: Unlinks an external issue (e.g., from Jira/GitHub), identified by `external_issue_id`, from the Sentry app installation specified by `uuid`.

inputSchema.description: Request model for deleting an external issue associated with a Sentry app installation.

external_issue_id.description: Platform-specific identifier of the external issue to be unlinked.
external_issue_id.title: External Issue Id

uuid.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the Sentry app installation.
uuid.title: Uuid

inputSchema.title: DeleteExternalIssueByUuidRequest

name: delete_external_issue_by_uuid

DeleteExternalIssueByUuidResponse.description:
Response model for the delete external issue operation.

Returns None/empty response on successful deletion (204 No Content).
Error responses (403 Forbidden, 404 Not Found) contain an optional detail field.

detail.description: Error detail message. Present only in error responses (403/404). Null for successful deletions.
detail.title: Detail
